intro.text: A listener woman who is one of the first to take warform.

items.text: Dianil volunteered to try the new warform with gemstones from Venli and was one of the dozen who succeeded. Standing in the highstorm, she felt overwhelmed by warform's rhythm. Right after, the new warforms heard drums warning of a raid and went with Sharefel to meet it; after Eshonai cowed the raiders and invited them to join, the group went to train.

appearance.text: Warform deepens her voice. She has a distinctive curl of black marbling along her brow.
